evidence.range_scope: Inherited universal rational corrected-heat identity, all twelve strictly positive pivot functions for r<-2, and all-affine analytic QC implication.
Fixed-r heat quantifier, density and periodic passage; negative-delta decomposition; no branch-uniform estimate asserted.

Exact necessary kernel rows plus analytic rigidity and inherited heat identity give strict Jensen positivity for each individual nonzero perturbation; no uniform constant.

Degree-half homogeneous heat renormalization, rough-data one-sided Fatou, one-dimensional compactness and rank-one bound prove a nonconstructive positive angular margin at each fixed r; fixed B annuli only.

Additive clarification gives all eight outer-product equations, full affine gradient in strictness, and normalized/angular amplitude condition at fixed B; small amplitudes create growing effective backgrounds.

Independent analytic reconstruction validates strictness, truncated critical heat renormalization, rough-data Fatou and angular compactness with accepted outer-product/full-affine/normalized-amplitude clarifications; uniform all-affine margin remains unproved.
Exact affine-minimized residual, numerical outputs as upper candidates only, missing all-affine uniform fourth-power margin and no sharp-J N866 transfer.
Independent exact kernel/scaling/polarization supporting checks only; does not adjudicate analytic strictness or angular compactness.
Existing margin 4nu/1875, no boundary constant from H subtraction, same-G 3/1250 and unchanged N866 fixed-integrand contract.
N866 needs a positive numerical uniform gradient-energy constant and a certified endpoint extension budget; strictness alone is insufficient.

notices.clarification: Strict Jensen and angular-margin claims have a completed independent internal analytic audit with accepted additive clarifications. They prove neither a positive all-affine pure-fourth-order constant nor a zero-margin sequence. Fixed-B angular closure additionally requires normalized profiles or the stated amplitude condition; shrinking amplitudes, growing effective backgrounds and general rank-two multiscale gradients remain open. No sharp-J storage transfer is established; the existing same-G N866 scope is unchanged.
notices.issue: Internally audited partial sharp-boundary progress is weaker than the required uniform bound
